title: A clip, cut out by name, placed somewhere new
pitch: A moving shot in. The subject found by a word on every frame, its matte, and the same motion over a new place out.
why: SAM 3.1 finds the subject from one word, frame by frame, so no one paints a mask. Wan 2.2 makes the shot, Z-Image makes the new place, and ACE-Step scores it.

models.name: SAM 3.1
models.note: Read Meta's SAM License before commercial use.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: One clear subject against a plain sky gives SAM the easiest job.

steps.label: The shot
steps.does: One subject against a plain sky.
steps.prompt: A bright red diamond kite with a long ribbon tail flies and dips in the wind against a plain pale blue sky. The camera stays still.

57:27.text: A wide lavender field at golden hour with rolling hills and a few trees on the horizon, warm low sun, soft haze, nothing in the sky.

steps.label: Found, cut, placed
steps.does: SAM 3.1 finds the kite on every frame from the word 'kite' and lays it over the new place. The matte is saved too.
